rules.cheap: Source 32733/32752/32753/32754: ANY.Wood 8000L, 340K, hardness1 resistance5; four plankAnyWood at 1U each, two long rods at1U each, lead/bismuth/bronze/brass; rGs/PSP/PSP with glue, soft hammer and saw.
rules.logistics: 32072 = tungsten drum32718 (6U W), 4W screws(U/9 each), ULV field emitter, generic storage bus; native original recipe retained and empty-storage guard added.
rules.known_components: Blank cover=Al(U+U/9); emerald processor=Pt U + Emerald U; ULV emitter=TinAlloy4U + Os4U/8 + EnderPearl U; storage bus=blank cover + emerald processor + Os2U/8. CR skips tools and automatic unknown circuit/glue data; no circuit data is invented.
rules.stacking: Source registration stack16 for ordinary containers; TileEntityBase08Barrel filled item stacks1. Native actual fluid amount controls filled limit independently of paint/modes.
rules.registry: Keep wood_barrel for the lead cheap variant; three new variant block/item IDs. Exact original same display names retained; variants differ by recipe and material composition.
rules.legacy: Explicit saved Capacity/Amount retained by existing storage restore and sparse item writer. Bare old wood_barrel stacks have no capacity identity and now inherit8000; no promise of historical-save migration.
rules.comparison: Original1.7.10 is authority. _w confirms source definitions. Previous brokestar/masson comparisons retain storage; no independent duplicate item/registry architecture adopted.

remaining: Historical saves and independent saved-world restart remain unverified
Complete powered survival processing remains unverified
Natural third-party wood tag providers and real external attachments not exercised
Other source wood species including Rainbowood barrels remain separate gaps
